An integrated franchise solution: adopting Logidam, Balju.com, and FDAM affordably with government funding

franchise order management, Logidam, Balju.com, FDAM, government funding, franchise solutions, HQ logistics management, store ordering app, franchise ERP, MS Venter

Key takeaways

· When order management runs on phone calls, text messages, and spreadsheets, mis-shipments, poor inventory visibility, and HQ-store conflict keep recurring.

· Logidam (logistics ERP) + Balju.com (store ordering app) handle the order management flow in one system.

· Add FDAM, the operations ERP, and HQ franchise sales, operations, and logistics all run on the same data.

· An opportunity is open for 10 companies, first come, first served, to adopt all three solutions using government funding.

Franchise order management is a core HQ operation: handling the flow of products and raw materials that headquarters supplies to stores within a defined logistics system. Because stores place orders and HQ receives and fulfills them every day, the efficiency and accuracy of order management are basic infrastructure for HQ operations.

MS Venter, which has focused on franchise IT for nearly 25 years, offers Logidam (logistics ERP) and Balju.com (store ordering app) for HQ order management, along with FDAM, the operations ERP that ties together HQ franchise sales, store openings, and operations. This article walks through why order management is structurally difficult, how the integrated solution works, and the opportunity to adopt it with government funding.

An integrated solution that ties orders between HQ and stores into one flow.

1. What is franchise order management?

In franchise operations, "order management" means stores placing orders and franchisor headquarters receiving and fulfilling them. Because HQ supplies products and raw materials to stores, the accuracy of this daily order flow is the deciding factor in HQ operating quality.

It goes beyond taking and shipping orders: HQ also needs to build up standardized data on which items it sent to which store and when. If the data doesn't flow, the same work has to be reorganized from scratch every time, and that burden grows quickly as stores are added.

2. Where does franchise order management get stuck?

Order management based on calls, texts, and spreadsheets hits its limits as stores grow.

Many franchisor headquarters still handle orders by phone, text message, handwritten documents, or spreadsheets. In this setup, HQ repeats the same work for every new store, and with data scattered, comparison and analysis become difficult.

Four recurring problems with manual order management

① Order mistakes and mis-shipments: manual records and verbal communication repeatedly lead to wrong quantities or items

② Inefficient workflows: repetitive paperwork increases the workload for both HQ and stores

③ Poor inventory visibility: without real-time inventory data, overstock and stockouts happen side by side

④ HQ-store communication problems: when order communication breaks down, it can lead to conflict between HQ and stores

These problems go beyond "frequent mistakes" to become structural obstacles to running HQ efficiently. Solving them requires changing the flow itself through a system.

3. How MS Venter's integrated solution solves it

HQ logistics and store ordering run on the same data.

MS Venter provides Logidam (logistics ERP) and Balju.com (store ordering app) together, designed so HQ's entire order management workload is handled inside the system. Built on experience working with about 500 brands, they mirror how headquarters actually work, so you can use them in a familiar flow right after adoption.

Four ways the order flow changes

① Digital order management: order status and inventory organized in one system

② Fewer mis-shipments, better accuracy: system-based information sharing prevents order mistakes

③ Automated inventory management and analysis: ERP-based automation keeps overstock and stockouts in check

④ Simpler HQ-store communication: ordering and payment handled in the same app, reducing sources of conflict

Note: Balju.com is a store ordering app designed to be used with Logidam, HQ's logistics ERP. The benefits of integrated operations show clearly only when HQ logistics data and store order data are connected in the same system, so it's most efficient to adopt the two solutions as a pair.

4. Add FDAM, the operations ERP, to integrate every area of HQ

An integrated lineup covering logistics, ordering, and operations together.

Once HQ order management moves into a system, it naturally becomes possible to tie HQ's other work areas into the same flow. MS Venter's FDAM operations ERP is an HQ-only ERP that handles franchise sales management (franchise inquiries, consultations, e-contracts), store-opening management (documents, interiors, training), and operations management (QSCV inspections, POS sales aggregation, store information) in one system.

If Logidam and Balju.com cover HQ's logistics and ordering axis, FDAM covers its sales and operations axis. When the three work together, everything from franchise sales to operations and logistics flows on the same data, so the HQ operations team can spend the time it used to spend re-gathering scattered data on decision-making instead.

Frequently asked questions

Q. Do we have to adopt all three solutions at once?

Logidam and Balju.com work best as a pair, while FDAM is a separate operations ERP you can adopt alongside them or on its own. We'll help design the order and scope of adoption based on the area your HQ wants to tackle first.

Q. Can we adopt Balju.com on its own?

Balju.com is a store ordering app designed to be used with Logidam, HQ's logistics ERP. The benefits of integrated operations appear only when HQ logistics data and store order data are connected in the same system, so it's most efficient to adopt the two solutions as a pair.

Q. Can an HQ without its own logistics apply?

Logidam and Balju.com are most effective where HQ runs logistics directly or through an outsourced provider. The right scope depends on your HQ's logistics structure, so we'll review your operating environment during the consultation before making recommendations.

Q. Which headquarters can use government funding?

Eligibility for government funding depends on your HQ's business type, revenue size, and the applicable program. During the consultation, we'll explain which programs and procedures are available to you and design the most suitable cost structure together.

Contact us through our main line (1544-7120, Korea), our KakaoTalk channel, or our consultation page, and we'll arrange a consultation tailored to your HQ. Reach out early within the application period and we'll move ahead on your schedule.
